answer: Identities register through an exponential fee escalator per funder. Step one: a wallet's first identity costs 100 tokens locked on-chain. Step two: each further identity from that source doubles the fee, so identity ten costs 102,400. Step three: the lock is refunded only on attestation by established peers, so builders reclaim capital and spammers burn it. Step four: funding-graph tracing catches wallet-splitting; linked wallets inherit the higher tier. 1,000 identities would exceed the whole supply. In a tundra where every oasis costs double, the echo of fake crowds fades fast.
